seo.title: Split Easy — Bill Splitter for iOS
seo.description: Split a bill to the cent. Add tax and tip, give someone a fixed amount, and every share adds up to the total. Saved people, history, widgets. No accounts, no ads.

hero.label: BILL SPLITTER
hero.title: Split the check to the cent.
text: Enter the bill, add tax and tip, and see what everyone owes as you type. The shares always add up to the total. No sign-up, no ads, no data collection.

items.title: Tax and Tip, Your Way
items.text: Enter tax as a rate or as the amount on the receipt. Pick a tip or set your own, on the bill before tax or with tax included.

items.title: Shares That Add Up
items.text: Every amount is rounded to the cent, and a leftover cent goes to the first person, so the shares always match the total.

items.title: Uneven Splits
items.text: Someone ordered more? Give them a fixed amount and everyone else splits the rest. You see everyone's share before you save.

items.title: People and Favorites
items.text: Names you use are saved, and your favorites come first when you add people to a bill.

items.title: History
items.text: Every split is saved with everyone's share. Share it again, or start a new bill with the same people in a tap.

items.title: Share Card
items.text: Send a clean card or plain text to the group chat, with each person's share and the bill behind it.

items.title: Widgets
items.text: Your last split on the Home Screen or the Lock Screen: what each person paid, at a glance.

items.title: Any Currency
items.text: Dollars, euros, yen, dinars and more, each with the right number of decimals and your region's formatting.

items.title: Your Accent
items.text: Pick one of eight accents to mark what each person pays. It sets the app icon too, with dark and tinted versions, and the widgets.

items.title: Day or Night
items.text: Follow your iPhone or pick Light or Dark. After dark, choose soft Graphite or true OLED Black.

items.title: Siri & Shortcuts
items.text: Say “Split a bill with Split Easy” to hear each share without opening the app.

sections.label: PRIVACY
sections.title: Your splits stay yours.
text: No accounts. No ads. No tracking. No cloud sync. Your splits and the people you split with live on your device and nowhere else.
